tool_args.rationale: All five observations share the same gradient, state, and horizon. The open-branch probe can distinguish the indicated mobility bridge from a gradient-independent saturating law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The saturating pilot varies only u_now, so it cannot distinguish recruitment from a gradient-dependent bridge mechanism.
The cheaper open-branch probe is targeted at the present mechanism ambiguity.
The pilot response saturates rather than remaining linear in u_now.
